QuestInfo.name: [Dragon Boat Festival] Fruit of Patience
QuestInfo.0: You should talk to Buhbear, the bear who wants to become human.
QuestInfo.1: The bear that's craving Zongzi hands you Magical Bamboo Leaves. Holding the leaves for 1 hour will turn them into Tasty Zongzi that you can give to the bear.
QuestInfo.2: The bear that's craving Zongzi hands you Magical Bamboo Leaves. Holding the leaves for 1 hour will turn them into Tasty Zongzi that you can give to the bear.

0.0: #h0#, I wish I could eat #bsteamed Zongzi#k filled with sticky glutinous rice and delicious ingredients wrapped in bamboo leaves. I happened to find these #bMagical Bamboo Leaves#k while I was wandering. \nWhy don't you use them to make Tasty Zongzi?

yes.0: If you hold the #bMagical Bamboo Leaves#k for 1 hour, you'll be able to make #bTasty Zongzi#k. I'll give you a gift if you bring some to me!

no.0: Ah...I really wanted to eat Tasty Zongzi. Please come back if you change your mind.
